en.topic_title: Women express frustration, concern over Nvidia boss Jensen Huang’s return
en.topic_summary:
News of Jensen Huang’s shocking return to Nvidia had barely landed when President Donald Trump posted an AI-generated image of the Nvidia cofounder holding up a red bra, surrounded by security personnel whisking him offstage, blood streaked across his face.



US President Donald Trump delivers remarks at the Donald J. Trump – John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts in Washington, D.C. on January 6, 2026. Photo: The White House, via Flickr.



The image was based on a real pho
